about: GTA 6 Extended Look deep dive (Delta, slug gta-afterdark): in Rockstar's 'An Extended Look' (Aug 27 2026, 'captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5') a run of night shots from 20:14 holds: a purple-lit tower, a selfie in a red car by a HOTEL DIXON sign, a pool party, a race at sunset, a packed dance floor and a woman holding a drink on a balcony (prompt DRINK R1 / DROP). In the race the HUD position goes 6/6 to 2/6 while its timer moves 00:04.79 to 00:08.26 and PROGRESS goes 5% to 10%. Sources in BRIEF.md.

lines.say: Under three and a half seconds.
